decision.reason: Siemens first-party CIIF press release confirms six embodied AI factory scenarios and related in-factory trial need.

opportunities.core_job: Capture pass/fail evidence, operator overrides and release readiness for embodied-AI trials on actual factory lines
opportunities.target_customer: Industrial robot integration teams and factory AI pilot acceptance engineers
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-entered task/scenario inventory, site/line ID, safety prerequisites, observation/result, operator intervention, incident, acceptance criteria and dated reviewer approval; no robot runtime integration
opportunities.why_now: Siemens China 12 October official CIIF statement documents opening six physical-AI in-factory scenarios for field testing and iteration, alongside a new reconfigurable production modeling rule.
opportunities.before_state: Physical AI pilot tests and site signoff evidence recorded separately by integrators.
opportunities.after_state: Versioned run acceptance matrix linking physical AI trial conditions, anomalies, operator handoffs and approval.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: CSV/manual input with deterministic browser comparison; competitor and history research deferred to Merge/Validation
